verdict.rationale: There is no first-party documentation of Metal or ARM optimizations. However, community evidence indicates Ollama moved to a native MLX backend on Apple Silicon. A hands-on M4 Pro benchmark shows strong throughput with optimized quantizations (int4 84.4 tok/s versus 30 tok/s for q4_K_M). An older report of slow MBP performance adds some uncertainty but does not contradict a vendor claim. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing Metal/MLX acceleration and native ARM builds, official performance guidance, and broader independent benchmarks.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: User benchmark on M4 Pro 48GB: qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q4_K_M eval rate 30.0, nvfp4 66.5, int4 84.4 tokens/sec via 'ollama run' with --verbose.
native mlx should mean better memory handling on apple silicon
